name: AMD integrated GPU · switch to swangle rendering (example)
author: ApkStart
description: On some AMD integrated GPUs with old drivers, -gpu host passes the emulator self-check, but the process crashes outright a dozen seconds after the guest boots (the log only shows AEHD is operational). Pinning the render backend to swangle works around it, at the cost of a slightly lower frame rate.

notes: If the picture is fine but games stutter, set Quality to 540×960 in Settings
Once it works, set enabled to true or delete that line and it applies automatically
